Xero does publish agent-oriented material: an AI Toolkit covering the OpenAI Agents SDK, an MCP server, LangChain and prompt examples, plus documented MCP server pages and official OpenAPI descriptions an agent could ingest. missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt file, evidence of agent-optimized or markdown doc formats, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can consume the docs effectively.
